messages:
meera patel: Heads up — the Python quickstart has a small but blocking mismatch. The env var in the snippet is `REDWOOD_API_KEY` but the SDK we ship (0.12.x) only looks for `REDWOOD_API_TOKEN`. I hit 401s trying to run the sample app.

sam kim: ack, thanks for flagging. do you have the exact page/link?

meera patel: https://docs.redwood.inference/quickstart/python (the "Set your creds" snippet under "Install and auth"). Copy/paste from the page: ```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="sk-test-..."
``` then in Python: ```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
print(client.generate("hello"))
``` yields `AuthenticationError: missing token` even though the env var is set.

jordan lee: oof, that's on me. we recently renamed the env var during the token->key rename and the docs patch must've missed this block.

ben rogers: quick question — in the newer async examples the Client init is `await Client.create()` in the docs, but the 0.12.x SDK doesn't have async constructor helpers yet. which runtime version is the docs targeting?

jordan lee: docs were updated ahead of the SDK release by mistake. so two problems: env var name + async snippet not yet shipped.

sam kim: can you paste the 401 stacktrace? helps triage whether it's env var lookup or token parsing.

meera patel: stack: ```
AuthenticationError: Missing API token. Please set REDWOOD_API_TOKEN or pass token=config.TOKEN
 at redwood.client._get_token (client.py:42)
```
So it is complaining about REDWOOD_API_TOKEN specifically.

jordan lee: thanks — I'll open a docs PR to change `REDWOOD_API_KEY` -> `REDWOOD_API_TOKEN` and add a note about the SDK version parity. Also will revert the async constructor snippet until we release the async init.

docs-bot: Link check report: /quickstart/python -> 200 OK, but /examples/async-starter returns 404 (newer example not yet published). (auto-generated)

ben rogers: for the SDK side, I'm going to add a fallback in 0.12.1 to accept either env var name (TOKEN or KEY) so we don't break users during the rollout. Will open a tiny PR.

meera patel: appreciated — thanks. Also maybe add a note in quickstart about the minimal repro: `pip install redwood==0.12.0` + `REDWOOD_API_TOKEN` set. Saves folks time. :thumbsup:

sam kim: assigning this to @jordan and @ben. Jordan — can you confirm the PR URL when ready so I can merge the quick patch?

jordan lee: yup. PRs: docs r= https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 and sdk r= https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/177 — both open, small changes.

meera patel: verified locally with the docs patch — updated snippet fixes it for me. thanks all. :pray:

sam kim: great. leaving this thread open until the SDK patch is released and CI link check clears the async example 404.

docs-bot: CI note: docs PR 482 passed link checks after edit, but flagged missing example asset; queued for publish.

jordan lee: SDK patch merged to main, will cut 0.12.1 in next release window. I'll follow up in #eng-releases once published.

meera patel: perfect — closing my end. cheers!
